# The tree every "fixture tree" transcript is served from.
#
#   dir  PATH MODE MTIME
#   file PATH MODE MTIME CONTENT
#   link PATH MODE MTIME TARGET
#
# PATH is relative to the export root, "." for the root itself. MODE is
# the octal permission bits, MTIME Unix seconds. CONTENT is hex:BYTES, or
# pattern:LENGTH for LENGTH bytes where byte i is i mod 251. The server
# exports the root as "/" and numbers nodes from 1 in depth-first order,
# visiting directory entries sorted by name: "." is 1.
dir  .              0755 915148800
file big.bin        0644 915148801 pattern:20000
dir  empty          0700 915148802
file hello.txt      0644 915148803 hex:68656c6c6f2c20776f726c640a
link link           0777 915148804 hello.txt
